name: 04-canvas-colors
eval: (function(){ const c=document.getElementById('cv'); const g=c.getContext('2d'); const d=g.getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data; const u=new Set(); let n=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=280){ u.add((d[i]>>4<<8)|(d[i+1]>>4<<4)|(d[i+2]>>4)); n++; } return JSON.stringify({sampled:n, distinctColors:u.size}); })()
